notes:
Context: Ministry-affiliated operator for regional critical radio/telemetry; looking to add LLM-based incident triage and operator chat assistant inside an air-gapped operations enclave.

Key constraints (as stated on calls):
- No outbound egress from enclave to public internet; all model hosting must be on-prem or in a physically isolated VPC with blocked egress.
- Must integrate with agency HSM (FIPS 140-2/3) for key wrap; binary signing/attestation requested for runtime images.
- Audit log retention 7+ years; immutable export to agency SIEM.
- SSO via SAML with SCIM provisioning; RBAC mapped to AD groups.

Performance & requirements:
- Workloads: operator chat (conversational incident triage), document search over manuals & playbooks, real-time alert summarization from telemetry streams.
- Latency target: p95 < 300ms for short chat requests; sustained concurrency target ~50 active sessions, burst to 200.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to trade higher infra cost for guaranteed isolation and deterministic dependencies.
- Model policy: prefer vetted open models; must be able to pin model versions, deploy quantized variants, and have automatic fallback to smaller model when requested capacity is exceeded (no outbound failover).

Quote highlights: "We cannot have any egress — even telemetry out — without a formal memo." 
"HSM integration and image attestation are non-negotiable for pilot sign-off." — CTO (ops sec lead).

POC plan discussed: 8-week POC scoped: 2-week on-site install prep (network, air-gap connectors), 2-week model onboarding + HSM integration, 2-week perf tuning & batching config, 2-week ops handoff + runbook. Must deliver: audit log export demo, SAML SSO flow, latency profile report, and fallback policy doc.

Commercial notes: procurement window opens FY Q2 2026; budget ring-fenced pending accreditation slot. Prefers multi-year reserved capacity if dedicated on-prem pricing acceptable.

Stated risks: longer accreditation path, external vendor approvals, and need for signed ATO-style attestation.

Suggested Redwood asks / action items:
- Provide air-gapped deployment checklist + minimal outbound requirements (one-pager).
- Technical runbook for HSM/KMS integration + sample attestation artifacts.
- Draft SOC/ISO evidence packet and NIST SP 800-53 mapping stub for Orion security team.
- Confirm support window for on-call SE during POC (onsite days + remote overlap).
